book.name: JON
book.title: JON Vurungan Rof Nane Jisas Krais Te Kirkir Iny E Jon

content: Jisas Garus Mour Matisian Tsunia

Tamanainy u nainy Guainy iny Fakats Fatabin ai tovei roman Jisas natiny ton nainy Tsunia te siruu ename te naus osing fi non Ya na monaagits to ana Ayei te naa fi en ten Taman. Ayei mangiir fiisok ir vainy fasito Tsunia fatoobing tana monaagits to ana Ya mangiir fiisok kainy ratuari onot tan fafakap nan nainy mat Tsunia.

Jisas an matisian Tsunia gum iny ainy ror tan sewaan tana ananerof. Ai Vinasaar faan iny ton fakats tsuan ten Judas a guei tsoiny ten Saimon Iskariot ma faan iny naa ya Jisas nimar a vainy ma atsuiny famat ari Ya.
Jisas nat faamuainy e Taman te fainy Yan fo mamatsiny parits, Ya naten nato, Ayei te poo fi me ten Gov ana Ayei kan te naa fi naa non ten Gov.
Ai Jisas tsun osing to na taran fious ton vau Tsuan iny jiarasan ana Ya pous iny ton sapsap Tsuan.

Ana Ya tsiiu iny to na aurom koman a kepaa na faakok ana Ya tanik iny garus ton mour matisian Tsunia ana Ya sap faparak ratuari fiisen men sapsap te popous iny Ya, kat to te faarei non a binun tan tsoiny binun.
Ya naa mito ten Saimon Pita ai Saimon Pita tsue to na ka Tsunia, “Fiisia Anyi komainy garus kainy rom a mou vanyo ge Tsunaun?”
Jisas biny towa sa tsue na ka, “Nyi gim rom ma natiny a ka te kat Ronyo tovei roman, sana nyi nai natem marom vou.”
Pita baainy sa tsue na ka, “Anyi gim on rom ma garus oiny a mou vanyo!” “Te gim fi Ronyo ma garus a moum manyi, nyi gim rom ma tap fiisen Vaminyo,” biny finy ya Jisas.
Saimon Pita biny Towa sa tsue na ka, “Tsunaun, garus tsuiny korei vaare na mou vanyo, garus me na nimau ana patsu vanyo kan!”

Jisas tsue to, “E sei na mes te sisiuf ee te kaamos faavot ovei nanon ana ya te gima onot ma sisiuf pis a tsivon, sana ayei te onot non ma garus tsuiny a moun nainy te kookuaf non ya. A fokinai tsumi ton kaamos sana isen tsumi na sikia.”
(Jisas nat faamuan iny e sei te faan iny non Ya nimar vainy te nai atsuiny ror Ya, ka te tsue fi ya nei, “A fokinai tsumin kaamos, sana isen tsumi na sikia.”)

Te garus fakap bus Ya na mou rari Jisas vau fatabiny pis ton vau iny jiarasan Tsunia ana Ya tabin fatabin enaa to tana pan Tsunia tana taran. “Fiisia, ami nat kan iny rom a ka te kat Anyo tsumi?” rangat fi Ya.
“Mi koo Vanyo na Tsoiny Tatagaa Ot ana Tsunaun te toobing non te tsue fi mi, tana saa Anyo tsun to.
Anyo na Tsunaun tsumi ana Tsoiny Tatagaa Ot, ana Nyo te see garus tsuiny rou a fo mou mami. Jesan, ami kan ma fauf a tsivom am garus ton fo isiseiny mou tsumi.
Nyo faatok bus mamin kat Tsonyo to te fauf finy Anyo na Tsivou, ma kat kan fi mi jesan te kat fi Nyo tsumi.
Nyo tsue faman of maromi a sikia ta isen ta tsoiny binun te karap fafis iny non a tsoiny tatagaa ot tsuan, ge na tsoiny gogovet vegiau te karap fafis iny non a mes te jiats naa non ya.
Mi nat bus iny a man nana fo kat to kat yam, ma nai kaa mimi na paparaa tsian te kat fi romi tsuri.
“Nyo gim rou ma tsue tsuk mami faavot Nyo nat rarori na vainy te pisainy Anyo. San vegiau tan Vegiau Ten Gov ma ruak iny man me,

content.text: ‘A mes te ainy a kainy ainy Tsonyo koma iring Varonyo.’ (Vadou 41.9)

content: Nyo tsue of bus mamin foka to tabuiny tapokaa non ya sai te ruak nats non ya, mi nai faaman Varonyo, Anyo na Ayei, a Mes to te pisainy e Gov ma Tsoiny Fiisaup Ya tana vainy.
Nyo tsue faman of maromi, e sei te faarof non a mes te jiats mi Ronyo ee, te faarof kainy Varonyo, ai sei te faarof Varonyo ee, te faarof non a mes to te jiats Vaminyo.”
Jisas Tsue Faruak Famuan Iny E Judas Te Nai Faan Iny Non Ya

Te vegiau fakap bus iny e Jisas a ka to, ana Ayei kaa miton koma patang koman Ya ana Ya tsue faruak to tsuri na fokinai, “Nyo tsue faman of maromi a isen fapoopoan namami nai faan iny Varonyo nimar a vainy ma nai atsuiny vanyo ri.”
Rin matisian fi mamatoong rato fapoopoan narari, ri fapinpin iny to e sei te tsue tsuk iny non Ya ee.
Jon a matisian to te mangiir fiisok non e Jisas gumgum en panan Ya.
Saimon Pita fasisiraa faamo of tsuiny vanyo sa tsue na ka, “Rangats, sei to aya te tsue tsuk iny non ya ee?”
Ana nyo fasak fasiruu naa to panan e Jisas ana nyo rangats Towa, “Tsunaun, e sei fatoobing to ayei ee?”

Jisas biny towa sa tsue na ka, “Nyo nai fabub rou a painy koinykoiny to koman kobuu Nyo te faan iny ya tsunia ayei nan a mes.” Ana Ya nom to na painy koinykoiny sa fabub ya ana Ya faan iny towa ten Judas a guei tsoiny ten Saimon Iskariot.
Te nom e Judas a painy koinykoiny to ai Satan sof towa sa tagaa ot iny ya. Jisas tsue to tsunia, “Veesau tsun kat a ka te komainy kat rom anyi!”
Sana sikia ta isen tsuri te kaa tana taran ma nat kat fei sen Jisas tsue iny a ka to tsunia ei.
Judas, ayei na tatagaa ot tana poraa moni mam mes matisian pon iny to Jisas te tsue of ya ma nai foiny ta ka te komainy romam nan guainy, ge te tsue of ya ma faan ir yan vainy aaruts ta ka.
Judas ainy to na painy koinykoiny sa tafuts veesau tsun en. Te voiny busen ana ya tafuts to.
Faun A Foun

Te tafuts bus na Judas, ai Jisas tsue to, “U nainy te nom non a Guei Tsoiny te Bobot e Gov sa ruak iny Mes men asangan iny vamarits ruak nats non, an Siinaiv ten Gov te nai afis Varonyo ai Gov te nom kainy asangan iny vamarits, tana saa ito tan fo mamatsiny ka to te nai ruak non Tsonyo.
Ai to te pokei Ronyon asangan iny vamarits ten Gov, Gov patsukanen nai pokei non a asangan iny vamarits tana Guei Tsoiny te Bobot e Gov sa ruak iny Mes me, ana Ayei kat veesau tsuiny non ya.

Fuainy guei Tsiau, Nyo nai kaa taataun tsun fiisen maromi. Mi te nai sainy vavis Vanyo to te tsue of Anyo rin tsoiny mumua tana taa Jiu, sin tovei Nyo tsue of maromi, ‘Tana pan te naa Ronyo mi gim rom ma naa me.’
A faun a foun to te tsue faparits of marom yam mi ma mangiir isiseiny mes. To te mangiir fi Nyo mi, jesan mi ma mangiir isiseiny mes.
To te kaa mirom min mangiir tan isiseiny mes a fokinai faavot te nat maromi, amin fuainy matisian Tsonyo.”
Jisas Tsue Pita Nai Faungis Iny Non Ya
Saimon Pita rangats Towa, “Fei te naa fi rom Anyi ei Tsunaun?” Jisas biny towa sa tsue na ka, “Nyi gim rom ma vovou on Vanyo tan ar nainy to tana pan te naa Ronyo sin vou, nyi nai vovou Varonyo.”
“Tsunaun, kat fei ma gima vovou im roman ei?” te rangat fi Pita. “Nyo kakoun you ma mat of Manyi!”

Jisas biny towa sa tsue na ka, “Anyi kakoun faman rom ma mat of Vanyo? Nyo tsue faman of marom anyi tabuiny kokorooto non a koriou a tsoiny nyi nai faungis Varonyon fopis nainy, nyi gim rom ma nat Vanyo.”
